```{r}
for(i in seq_len(nrow(Player))){
  
  player <- Player$Player[i]
  
  start_season <- max(2019, Player$FirstSeason[i])
  
  cat("=========================================\n")
  cat("Player :", player, "\n")
  cat("Seasons:", start_season, "-", 2024, "\n")
  
  tryCatch({
    
    nba_player_db(
      Player     = player,
      seasons    = start_season:2024,
      export_csv = TRUE
    )
    
    cat("✓ Success\n")
    
  }, error = function(e){
    
    cat("✗ Failed :", e$message, "\n")
    
  })
  
  cat("Waiting 10 seconds before next player...\n\n")
  Sys.sleep(10)
  
}
```
